description: Convert a 3D model to STL format using the Trimesh library. STL is unitless: scale and axis changes are applied to the vertices.
inputInstructions:
Converts a 3D model to STL (.stl). Select the source model as the input file; the converted file is written back to the asset.

A point cloud has no triangles and is refused; convert it to PLY, OBJ, GLB, GLTF or USD instead.

STL stores no unit or axis. With the defaults (auto and keep) the geometry is written as read. To change the unit or axis, set the target. The source unit or axis must then be known: declared by the file (USD, DAE, 3MF, glTF) or set in Source units and Source up axis. A run that needs an unknown source fails with a message naming the option.

This pipeline reads no asset or file metadata. Everything it needs comes from the selected file and this template.

tagSchema.label: Source units
tagSchema.description: Unit of the numbers in the source file. auto uses the unit the file declares and applies no scaling to a file that declares none (STL, OBJ, PLY, OFF, XYZ).

tagSchema.label: Target units
tagSchema.description: Unit to scale the geometry to. keep leaves the scale unchanged. Any other value needs a known source unit, declared by the file or set in Source units.

tagSchema.label: Source up axis
tagSchema.description: Which axis points up in the source file. auto uses the axis the file declares and assumes none for a file that declares none.

tagSchema.label: Target up axis
tagSchema.description: Which axis points up in the result. keep leaves the orientation unchanged. y or z rotates the geometry and needs a known source up axis.
